# fastspec

> Dynamic OpenAPI, Discovery, and GraphQL spec client for Python — turn any API spec into a fully-typed async client with attribute chaining, streaming, and file uploads

## Modules

- [fastspec.gql](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/fastspec/gql.html.md): GraphQL client: distill a schema once, then build schema-checked queries by attribute chaining, batched into single requests
